answer_text: HA split-brain is when both Sockets have the Master role at the same time. In CMA you can identify it on the Socket page: both the primary and secondary Sockets will show Master (and you can view the Keepalive status to confirm). During a split-brain, there isn’t a single Socket carrying all the traffic because both are Masters. In GCP deployments, existing traffic can continue through both the primary and secondary vSockets during split-brain.
